evidence.excerpt: We present Smol-VL-BLV, a compact VLM for blind and low-vision users that closes this gap using a 500M decoder transformer model and two post-training mechanisms: (1) teacher-student distillation and (2) Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a composite BLV reward targeting directional language, metric distances, and hazard detection.
